sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. After a recent loss, Sandbach will be looking to bounce back against struggling Alsager Town, who sit bottom of the league with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, a chance to maintain pressure on Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in what could be a closely contested affair as Eccleshall seek to capitalize on recent form. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, host Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture on Wednesday 7 October before facing Brereton Social the same day. In-form sides Bilston Town and Barnton face each other when Foley Meir host Bilston on Saturday, while Barnton visit Shawbury United, who have lost their last five matches and are in poor form. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills, with both teams seeking momentum. Cheadle Heath Nomads, struggling near the bottom, travel to Telford Town, who occupy the third-lowest position. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-table encounter, and Widnes Town, pointless after 7 games, visit Brereton Social on Saturday.
